scope: Prove provider identity zero-residual behavior and durable item-attempt concurrency on disposable loopback PostgreSQL, then fail closed on legacy duplicate RUNNING scopes before migration 0081.
implemented_contract: The database allows at most one RUNNING item attempt for each batch_id, asset_code and phase through the conditional unique constraint dc_item_one_running.
begin and interrupted recovery lock the parent batch before attempt rows, use one stable batch-to-attempt lock order and fail closed when the batch is missing.
Migration 0081 scans historical RUNNING scopes first and emits a stable conflict scope instead of deleting, merging or rewriting append-only evidence.
Real QuoteSnapshotRepository and ValuationFactRepository calls preserve complete existing-row fingerprints on substituted, missing and duplicate provider identities.
Quote, current valuation and single valuation identity rejection carries PROVIDER_ASSET_IDENTITY_MISMATCH and never invokes a Publication publisher.

Independent PostgreSQL backends prove one-winner begin, database-level active-lease exclusion, one terminal finish, recovery-versus-finish convergence and single interrupted recovery while fresh RUNNING evidence remains active.

independent_review.result: No P0. Initial P1 findings for append-only fixture cleanup, migration duplicate preflight, same-binding begin/partial-index evidence, terminal field consistency and current-data governance were resolved before commit.
retained_open_gates: Full-universe scale evidence for the production denominator remains required.
Policy-hash-bound numeric tolerance reconciliation for all four Publications remains required.
Genuine current production authority and explicit production-write authorization remain required.

postgresql_migration_apply.detail: data_center.0081 recorded and dc_item_one_running catalog index created; a later unrelated global auth permission varchar(50) post_migrate signal failed after the migration transaction committed.
postgresql_migration_apply.index_definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dc_item_one_running ON public.data_center_sync_item_attempt USING btree (batch_id, asset_code, phase) WHERE state = 'running'

postgresql_duplicate_preflight.detail: Two disposable historical RUNNING rows in one scope were rejected by the stable 0081 preflight before constraint creation.

governance.reason: PostgreSQL identity/concurrency repository gates are closed; production-scale, numeric tolerance and genuine authority/write authorization remain open.

remaining_repository_gates: Measure item-attempt write and recovery behavior at the frozen full-universe denominator and optimize only if task budgets require it.
Produce policy-hash-bound numeric tolerance evidence for all four frozen Publications.
